quiz_payload.question: 🎯 Milestone Check 1: Pehli baar ZINDA (Living) koshika ki khoj talab ke paani me kisne ki thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Hooke = Dead Wood (Cork), Leeuwenhoek = Living Water (Talab ka paani)!

revision_points.point: Hooke (1665) = Dead Cork Cell Wall | Leeuwenhoek (1674) = Living Pond Water Cell.
Plants = Cellulose | Fungi = Chitin. Animal Cells lack Cell Wall.
Mitochondria & Chloroplast contain their OWN DNA and Ribosomes.
Ribosome = Protein | SER = Lipid & Drug Detox | Golgi = Courier | Lysosome = Suicide Bag | Tonoplast = Vacuole Membrane.
Mitosis = Growth/Repair (2n -> 2n, 2 cells) | Meiosis = Reproduction (2n -> n, 4 cells).

final_quiz_payload.question:
🏆 Master Challenge: Which of the following statements is/are CORRECT?
1. Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER) helps in detoxifying poisons in liver cells.
2. Mitochondria and Chloroplasts contain their own DNA.
3. Lysosomes are formed by the joint action of RER and Golgi body.
final_quiz_payload.explanation: Teeno statements 100% correct hain! SER drug detox karta hai, Mitochondria/Chloroplast ke paas apna DNA hota hai, aur RER-Golgi milkar Lysosomes banate hain.
